item.title: 【Music Videos】[REQ VID] POV 2nd Music Video - ariana grande
item.description: does anyone happen to have the 2nd music video for “pov” by ariana grande? all i know is that the video was set in miami, and it showcases different types of love (featuring two male lovers, a family, a hospital scene, some dogs), and ariana at the beginning and the end of the video.
